questions.text: Average of five number is 56 which equal to 3rd number and also equal of average of highest and lowest number. Ratio of lowest two number is 7:8. Ratio of third and 4th number is 7:8. Find the average of 2nd and 4th number?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Average of 5 numbers = 56

⇒ Sum of 5 numbers = 56 × 5 = 280

3rd number = 56

Average of highest and lowest = 56

Ratio of lowest two numbers = 7 : 8

Ratio of 3rd and 4th numbers = 7 : 8

Formula used:

Average = Sum ÷ Number of terms

Calculations:

Let lowest two numbers be 7x and 8x

Average of lowest and highest = 56

⇒ (Lowest + Highest) ÷ 2 = 56

⇒ Lowest + Highest = 112

⇒ 7x + Highest = 112

⇒ Highest = 112 − 7x

Numbers are in increasing order:

1st = 7x

2nd = 8x

3rd : 4th = 7 : 8

⇒ 3rd = 7y , 4th = 8y

Given 3rd number = 56

⇒ 7y = 56

⇒ y = 8

⇒ 4th number = 8y = 64

Now sum of all numbers:

7x + 8x + 56 + 64 + (112 − 7x) = 280

⇒ 8x + 232 = 280

⇒ 8x = 48

⇒ x = 6

⇒ 2nd number = 8x = 48

⇒ 4th number = 64

Required average:

⇒ (48 + 64) ÷ 2 = 112 ÷ 2 = 56

∴ The average of 2nd and 4th numbers is 56.

questions.text: The average salary of 800 employees in a company was calculated to be ₹450. Later, it was found that the salaries of three employees were incorrectly recorded as ₹150, ₹250, and ₹356 instead of ₹200, ₹300, and ₹400 respectively. The correct average salary is:
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick

Net Increase in total salary = (200 + 300 + 400) − (150 + 250 + 356) = 900 − 756 = 144.

Increase in Average = Net Increase ÷ Number of Employees = 144 ÷ 800 = 0.18.

Correct Average = Old Average + Increase = 450 + 0.18 = ₹450.18.

∴ The correct answer is ₹450.18.

Alternate Method

Given: Number of employees = 800, Incorrect Average = ₹450, Incorrect values = 150, 250, 356, Correct values = 200, 300, 400.

Formula: Correct Average = [ (Incorrect Average × n) − (Sum of wrong values) + (Sum of correct values) ] ÷ n

⇒ Incorrect Total Salary = 800 × 450 = 3,60,000

⇒ Sum of wrong recordings = 150 + 250 + 356 = 756

⇒ Sum of correct recordings = 200 + 300 + 400 = 900

⇒ Correct Total Salary = 3,60,000 − 756 + 900 = 3,60,144

⇒ Correct Average = 3,60,144 ÷ 800

⇒ Correct Average = 450.18

∴ The correct answer is ₹450.18.

Additional Information

Weighted Average

When groups have different sizes, the combined average is (n1x1 + n2x2) ÷ (n1 + n2).

Average Deviation Method

Correct Average = Old Average + (Net Change ÷ Total Observations). This avoids large multiplications.

Sum of Observations

Total Sum = Average × Number of items. Always check if the number of items changes after correction.

questions.text: Average of five consecutive even numbers for series I is 14 and average of six consecutive even numbers for series II is 27. Find the average between 2nd number in series I and 4th number in series II.
questions.explanation:
Solution:

Consecutive even numbers = x, (x + 2), (x + 4), (x + 6) and (x + 8)

(x + (x + 2) + (x + 4) (x + 6) + (x + 8)) = 5 ×  14 

5x + 20 = 70

5x = 50

x = 10

2 nd number in series I = (10 + 2) = 12

Consecutive even numbers in series II = y, (y + 2), (y + 4), (y + 6), (y + 8) and (y + 10)

(6y + 30) = 162

6y = 132

y = 22

4t number in series II = (22 + 6) = 28

Required average = (28 + 12)/2 = 20

questions.text: The average height of 35 students was calculated to be 160 cm. It was detected later that one value of 170 cm was wrongly copied as 135 cm for the computation of the average. Find the correct average.
questions.explanation:
Given:

Average height of 35 student = 160 cm

Wrongly copied height = 135 cm

Correct height = 170 cm

calculation:

Incorrect sum of the heights of 35 student = (160× 35) cm = 5600 cm

So, correct sum of the heights of 35 students = (incorrect sum) - (wrongly copied item) + (actual item) = (5600 - 135 + 170) cm = 5635 cm

Correct average = correct sum/total number of student = (5635/35) cm = 161 cm

 ∴ The correct average height is 161 cm.

questions.text: A cricketer has an average of 47.5 after playing for 20 innings. If he scores 300 runs in his next few innings, his average becomes 50 and then he takes retirement. Find the number of innings he played till his retirement.
questions.explanation:
Given:

Average after 20 innings = 47.5

His total score in next few innings = 300

Average after retirement = 50

Concept used:

Total runs scored = Number of innings × average score

Calculation:

Let the number of innings he played more after 20 innings be x

Total innings played = 20 + x

Average after his retirement = 50

Total runs scored at the time of his retirement = 50 × (20 + x)

⇒ 1000 + 50x    ---- (i)

Now, average after 20 innings = 47.5

Total runs scored after 20 innings = 47.5 × 20

⇒ Total runs scored after 20 innings = 950

After that he played few innings in which he scored 300 runs

So, Total runs scored at the time of his retirement = 950 + 300

⇒ Total runs scored at the time of his retirement = 1250    ---- (ii)

Now, equating equation (i) and (ii)

⇒ 1000 + 50x = 1250

⇒ 50x = 250

⇒ x = 5

Total innings played till his retirement = 20 + x

⇒ Total innings played till his retirement = 20 + 5

⇒ 25 innings

Shortcut Trick

Number of inning = Total run/Average

Total run in 20 innings be = 47.5 × 20 = 950 Runs

In few more innings he made 300 more run so, Total run he made = 950 + 300 = 1250 Runs

New average = 50

∴ Number of total innings = 1250/50 = 25 innings

questions.text: The average age of 20 students of a class is 12 years. Now a student whose age is 15 years leaves the class, and another student whose age is 13 years enters the class. Find the new average age of the class (in years).
questions.explanation:
Given:

Average age of the class = 12 years

Total number of students in the class = 20

Age of the student leaving the class = 15 years

Age of the student entering the class = 13 years

Formula Used:

Total of ages of all the students = Average age of the class × Total number of students in the class

Calculation:

We obtain the new total age of the class as:

(12 × 20) - 15 + 13 = 238 years

So, the new average age of the class = 238/20 = 11.9 years

∴ The new average age of the class is 11.9 years

questions.text: A team of 8 persons joins in a shooting competition. The best marksman scored 85 points. If he had scored 92 points, the average score for the team would have been 84. The number of points, the team scored was
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 1.

Given: 

A team of 8 persons joins in a shooting competition. The best marksman scored 85 points.

Calculation:

⇒ If the best marksman had scored 92 points, the average would have been 84.

So, total points = 8 x 84 = 672

But the original points of the best marksman was 85 instead of 92.

So, the difference is = 92 - 85 = 7

Hence, the team score is = 672 - 7 = 665

questions.text: There are 18 books in a library which average cost is Rs. 9000. Out of which 3 books A, B and C are taken out in which A’s price is 25% more than B and C’s price is 25% less than B. Find the price of A if the average of remaining books is Rs. 7000.
questions.explanation:
Given:

Average of 18 books = Rs. 9000

Price of A = 25% more than B

Price of C = 25% less than B

Average of remaining books = Rs. 7000

Concept used:

Total price of books = Number of books × Average price of books

Calculation:

Let the price of B = 100x

Then price of A will be 125x

And price of C will be 75x

Total price of A, B and C = 100x + 125x + 75x

⇒ 300x

Now, Average price of 18 books = Rs. 9000

Total price of 18 books = Rs. 9000 × 18

⇒ Rs. 162,000

Now, average price of 15 books = Rs. 7000

⇒ Rs. 105,000

Now, Total price of 18 books will be equal to total price of 15 books + Total price of A, B and C

⇒ 162,000 = 105,000 + 300X

⇒ 300x = 57,000

⇒ x = 190

Now, price of A = 125x

⇒ Rs. (125 × 190)

∴ The price of A is Rs. 23,750

questions.text: There are 40 boys in a PG. Due to some family reasons, 10 students leave PG. After this, the total expenses for the mess were decreased by Rs 30 while the average expenditure per head increased by Rs. 5. What was the original average expenditure of a boy in PG?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Total boys in PG = 40

Number of boys who leave PG = 10

Decrements in the expenditure of PG = Rs. 30 

Increment in the average expenditure of each person = Rs. 5 per person

Formula used:

Average = the sum of all numbers/total number

Calculation:

Total boys in PG = 40

Let the initial average expenditure of PG be Rs. x

The sum of their expenditure = 40 × x = Rs. 40x

Due to some family reason,

Now the total boys in PG = 40 - 10 = 30

Decrements in the expenditure of PG = Rs. 30 

So now the sum of their expenditure = Rs. (40x – 30)

Then now the average expenditure of each member = (40x – 30)/30

But there is an increment of Rs. 5 in the average expenditure of each person

Then,

⇒ x + 5 = (40x – 30)/30

⇒ 30x + 150 = 40x – 30

⇒ 10x = 180

⇒ x = 18

∴ The average initial expenditure of per person in PG is Rs. 18.

questions.text: A beach in Chennai has an average of 650 visitors on Sundays and 300 on other days. If a month of 29 days begins with Sunday, then, what is the average no of visitors per day in the month? (approximately)
questions.explanation:
Given:

Visitors in Sunday = 650

Visitors in other days = 300

Days in given month = 29

Formula:

Average no of visitors per day = total visitors in month / days in month

Calculation:

Since the month begins with a Sunday, there will be five Sundays in the month.

Then the number of visitors on 5 Sundays = 650 × 5

The number of visitors on remaining 24 days = 300 × 24

Required average = (650 × 5 + 300 × 24)/29

⇒ (3250 + 7200)/29 = 360.34 = 360 (approximately)

∴ The average number of visitors per day is 360.
